title: One action per generated clip
statement: Ask a video generator for one main action per clip and no cut inside it, since a clip asked to carry a sequence produces one that cannot be edited out.
detail: The motion rules of an intro-video BrainLift for a Grade 3 reading course ask for one main action per clip and no cut inside a clip, because a clip asked to carry a sequence of events produces one, and it cannot be edited out afterwards; transitions belong to the edit, not to the model (`downloads/BrainLift - What makes a good intro video.md`, lines 978 to 981). It is a house rule for generated video; no outcome was measured.
